tables.title: E12. Duplicates over a season of packs (pdl-s2)
tables.measured: 1000 simulated players, 2 rounds (seasonPeriods). 10 welcome packs after round 1, then 3 or 5 packs after every round; the pack pool after round r is each team's last series up to r (packPool, openPack as on the site, TOTW chance 25%). Cells: mean (p10 / median / p90). A duplicate is a card whose exact id the player already had; "players" counts player-and-team pairs (deckKey); a complete team has all five roles held.
